_comment: Shared merchant-binding cases, read by the test suite in every port. parse_cases feed SEEL_RETAILER_MERCHANTS through the port's startup parser: 'expected' is the parsed table, 'error': true means startup must refuse it. binding_cases drive a real request through the port's handler. Build the body from the 'quote: complete payload' or 'order: complete payload' case in validation-cases.json (by 'route'), then set merchant_id to body_merchant_id, or remove the key when body_merchant_id is null. single_merchant_id is SEEL_MERCHANT_ID and retailer_merchants is SEEL_RETAILER_MERCHANTS already parsed (null means unset). origin is the Origin request header (null means none is sent). Expect the response status; for 200, the merchant_id the upstream received; for 403, the exact error; and the Access-Control-Allow-Origin header (null means it must be absent). Every port must stamp the merchant it resolved, never the body value.

parse_cases.name: keys are lowercased and lose a trailing slash
an empty object is a valid, empty table
top level must be an object
a number is not a merchant ID
null is not a merchant ID
an empty string is not a merchant ID
two spellings of one origin cannot name two merchants

binding_cases.name: partner platform: a known origin stamps its merchant
partner platform: the Origin header matches case-insensitively
partner platform: a body merchant_id that agrees is accepted
partner platform: a body merchant_id naming another retailer is refused
binding_cases.error: merchant_id in the request body does not match the merchant for this storefront

binding_cases.name: partner platform: an unknown origin is refused
binding_cases.error: request origin is not a registered storefront

binding_cases.name: partner platform: a missing origin is refused even with a body merchant_id
binding_cases.error: request origin is not a registered storefront

binding_cases.name: partner platform: create order stamps the origin's merchant
partner platform: create order refuses a mismatched body merchant_id
binding_cases.error: merchant_id in the request body does not match the merchant for this storefront

binding_cases.name: single retailer: SEEL_MERCHANT_ID overrides the body
demo: with nothing configured the body merchant_id is forwarded
